groups.label: Early employee, not an officer or director (non-affiliate): 180-day lock-up with timed early releases
groups.groupQuote: All other outstanding shares of our common stock are subject to the Transfer restrictions described above until immediately after the close of the trading day on the 180th day after the date of this prospectus (such period of time, the “180-day lock-up period”), subject to the early release provisions described below.
groups.groupNote: The filing does not name who sits in the 180-day group; it says 'All other outstanding shares' are in it and only 'certain shares' of 'several of our shareholders' (not Mr. Musk) are in the longer 'extended lock-up period' (pp.271-272). An ordinary early employee is modelled as 'all other'. Both reads made the same assumption. Percentages are of the holder's locked shares; the filing gives them as percent of the group's shares (p.259 table).

groups.label: Founder-CEO (Mr. Musk; officer, director, affiliate): 366-day lock-up, no early release
groups.groupQuote: Our founder has agreed with the underwriters that all of the shares of our common stock owned by him are subject to the restrictions described above until immediately after the close of the trading day on the 366th day after the date of this prospectus. In addition, our founder may make Permitted Transfers (as defined in our charter), subject to the restrictions described in clauses (A), (B), and (D) of paragraph a. above. Our founder’s shares are not subject to any early release provisions during the lock-up period.
groups.groupNote: Not playable on the live card: the only release is 2027-06-14, after the card window.

Filing: restrictions last 'until immediately after the close of the trading day on the 366th day' (p.271); the p.259 table dates it 'June 12, 2027 (366th day after the date of this prospectus)', a Saturday, so the first day shares can be sold is Monday 2027-06-14.
